post.reply.description: The action of a post that replies to it.

post.boost.description: The action of a post that boosts it, and the item of its boost menu that boosts it or takes the boost back.

post.unboost.description: The item of a boosted post's boost menu that takes the reader's boost back.

post.quote.description: The item of a post's boost menu that writes a post quoting it.

post.favourite.description: The action of a post that favourites it, or takes the favourite back.

post.react.description: The action of a post that reacts to it with an emoji.

post.more.description: The button of a post that opens the menu of its other actions.

post.more_shortcut.description: In the keyboard shortcuts dialog, the row of the key that opens a focused post's more menu; says what the key does, unlike the button's name More.

post.boosted_by.description: The context line over a post that someone boosted into the timeline; name is the display name of who boosted it.

post.replying_to.description: The context line over a reply; handle is the account it replies to, as @user.

post.reactions.description: The accessible name of the row of a post's emoji reactions.

post.reaction.description: The accessible name of an emoji reaction chip: the emoji (a Unicode emoji or :shortcode:) and how many reacted with it.

post.reaction_mine.description: The accessible name of the reader's own emoji reaction chip, a toggle that is on: the emoji, how many reacted with it, and that the reader is one of them; pressing it takes the reader's reaction back.

post.translate.description: The action under a post in another language that shows it translated into the reader's language.

post.translated_from_by.description: The note under a translated post; language is the name of the language it was written in, provider the name of the translation service.

post.translated_by.description: The note under a translated post when the language it was written in is not known; provider is the name of the translation service.

post.translated_from.description: The note under a translated post when the translation service has no name; language is the name of the language it was written in.

post.translated.description: The note under a translated post when neither its language nor the translation service is known.

post.original.description: The action under a translated post that shows it again as it was written.

post.visibility.public.description: What the visibility glyph of a public post says, beside its time.

post.visibility.local.description: What the visibility glyph of a local post says, beside its time: on its server's local timeline, and outside its server to the author's followers alone.

post.visibility.unlisted.description: What the visibility glyph of a public post kept out of the public timelines says, beside its time.

post.visibility.private.description: What the visibility glyph of a post for its author's followers alone says, beside its time.

post.visibility.direct.description: What the visibility glyph of a post for the accounts it mentions alone says, beside its time.

post.copy_link.description: The item of a post's more menu that copies the link to the post.

post.open_original.description: The item of a remote post's more menu that opens the post's page on its own server.

post.share.description: The item of a post's more menu that shares it through the device's share sheet.

post.bookmark.description: The item of a post's more menu that bookmarks it.

post.unbookmark.description: The item of a bookmarked post's more menu that takes the bookmark back.

post.edit.description: The item of the more menu of the reader's own post that edits it.

post.delete.description: The item of the more menu of the reader's own post that deletes it after a confirmation (hence the ellipsis).

post.mute.description: The item of a post's more menu, under the author's handle, that mutes the author.

post.block.description: The item of a post's more menu, under the author's handle, that blocks the author after a confirmation (hence the ellipsis).

post.report.description: The item of a post's more menu, under the author's handle, that reports the post to the moderators after a form (hence the ellipsis).

post.shortcuts.description: The heading of the group of keyboard shortcuts that act on a post, in the keyboard shortcuts dialog.
